name: Spellwarping Curse
description:
Concentration, up to 1 minute.

Roll Spirit vs Spirit against a creature within medium range. On a win, each time the creature casts a spell or invokes a magical trait that deals damage or forces a creature to make an opposed skill check, it takes damage equal to 1d8 + the creature's HEART score. Half damage on a loss.
successes:
✨: +1d damage.

🌞: Whenever the triggering event happens, the creature also becomes the target of its own spell or magical trait.
